QuestInfo.name: The Poor, the Rich, and the Phantom
QuestInfo.0: With your newfound status, you've gotten the Black Wings' attention. It would be wise to learn some new skills.
QuestInfo.1: This time, go to the secret vault at #b#m260000000##k. If things are as they were, you should have quite a fortune of treasures buried there from the unfortunately rich citizens of the desert. Onwards to #m260010600#!
QuestInfo.2: #m260000000# hasn't changed a bit! The barren land stays barren, the poor stay poor, and the rich stay rich. What a dump.

0.1: I remember documenting the advancement quite thoroughly, despite Raven's belligerent accusations of me 'going soft in the brain' for wanting to write things down.
0.2: #b#m260000000##k. I remember securing a vault behind #b#m260010600##k. That was around the time I came up with a new technique for robbing the rich of #m260000000#. Ah, good times.
0.3: Shall I go? I wonder how much #m260000000# has changed.\r\n#b#e<You will be moved to #m260000000# #m260010601# if you accept.>#n#k

no.0: Let's see, I made a list of the vaults I kept and stored that... in one of my vaults.

0.0: The people should grovel in awe now that I've reached level 60, but I don't know that the Black Wings will be so easily impressed. I'll need a 3rd Job Advancement to really put a pin in their seats.

1.0: Hundreds of years and not a thing changes. #m260000000# is the same desolate wasteland full of rich creeps. The same place I left it all behind to become something more...

yes.0: Maybe after I find that vault, I'll pay some of them a visit.
